messages:
zoe: Heads-up, merged PR #1208 changed the tracing export to use `trace_hex_id` (hex string) instead of the old `trace_context_id` (base64). Console examples for structured trace->cost pairing now fail to parse the exported trace id and the SDK snippets that stitch traces to dashboard entries are broken.

paul: oh no. which pages show the old key?

zoe: docs/console/observability/traces.md, examples/tracing/trace_to_dashboard.py, and the Node embedding that maps traces to cost events. The playground preview shows a parser error when the tracing hook runs.

nina: is the server already only emitting `trace_hex_id`? or do we still produce both?

zoe: backend changed in PR 1208 to emit only `trace_hex_id`. The change was to standardize on hex for interop with other observability tools. The docs change didn't land before backend.

paul: short-term fix: patch docs/examples to accept `trace_hex_id` and add a small compatibility snippet showing how to convert base64 -> hex for older saved dashboards. Also add a note in traces.md about the format change.

nina: longer term we should update SDK helpers that create the mapping key from the trace id. I'll prepare a helper function like `NormalizeTraceID(input) -> hex` in node/python/go SDKs and add it to the snippets.

build-bot: docs CI failure: examples/tracing/trace_to_dashboard.py schema parse error (unknown property: trace_context_id). See https://ci.redwood/inference/1208/build/4

zoe: i'm drafting the doc blurb. proposal below (short):

"Migration note: Tracing ID format change
The Console tracing export now uses `trace_hex_id` (lowercase hex string). If you previously used `trace_context_id` (base64), convert using: `echo base64id | base64 -d | xxd -p -c 256` or use our NormalizeTraceID helper in the SDKs. Existing saved dashboards that read the old key will need their panel config updated; we provide a converter script in the examples folder."

paul: that looks good. can you add the converter script example? a tiny python one-liner would be helpful.

zoe: adding converter snippet:
```
# convert base64 trace -> hex
import base64,sys
b = base64.b64decode(sys.stdin.read().strip())
print(b.hex())
```

nina: i'll open SDK PRs for NormalizeTraceID and update snippets to call it. i'll keep the function backward-compatible to accept either format for 6 weeks and then remove the fallback.

paul: plan: (1) zoe lands docs PR that updates examples and adds migration note + converter; (2) nina lands SDK helper and updates generated snippets; (3) regen snippets and run playground canary for 1 hour; (4) backend has already rolled, so once snippets and docs are in sync we can close the loop.

zoe: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1215  updates traces.md, adds converter and example updates. Requesting paul for review.

build-bot: docs PR 1215: example generation failed initially, then passed after minor tweak. See https://ci.redwood/inference/1215/build/2

nina: SDK PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/77 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/88  add NormalizeTraceID + tests.

paul: thanks. after nina's SDK merges i'll trigger snippet regen and then merge docs. Assigned: zoe -> docs PR and converter, nina -> SDK helper and snippet updates, paul -> final docs sign-off and canary monitoring.

zoe: adding a small FAQ entry: "How to tell which trace ID format you have" with quick check: base64 strings contain +/= characters; hex only contains 0-9a-f. Will include that in traces.md.

paul: perfect. :thumbsup:
